blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 了解稀釋後消毒劑的使用期限（In-Use Expiration Dating）原則，以及容器標示的法規要求。
blocks.en: Understand the principles of in-use expiration dating for diluted disinfectants, and the regulatory requirements for container labeling.

blocks.zh: 說明潔淨室環境管控的核心策略：從污染入侵管控到微生物增殖防制的完整框架。
blocks.en: Explain the core strategy of cleanroom environmental control: the complete framework from controlling the ingress of contamination to preventing microbial proliferation.

blocks.zh: 掌握物料、設備、清潔耗材進入無菌加工區（APA）的正確去污與滅菌程序。
blocks.en: Master the correct decontamination and sterilization procedures for materials, equipment and cleaning supplies entering the aseptic processing area (APA).

blocks.zh: 解讀環境監測（Environmental Monitoring, EM）數據趨勢，並識別異常偏差的應對邏輯。
blocks.en: Interpret trends in environmental monitoring (EM) data, and identify the logic for responding to abnormal deviations.

blocks.zh: 了解 In-Situ Field Studies（現場實地研究）的兩種方法——用於驗證清潔消毒程序在真實生產環境中的有效性。
blocks.en: Understand the two methods of in-situ field studies, which are used to verify that cleaning and disinfection procedures are effective in the real production environment.

blocks.zh: 6.0 In-Use Expiration Dating（使用中有效期標示）
blocks.en: 6.0 In-Use Expiration Dating

blocks.zh: 6.0 使用中有效期標示
blocks.en: 6.0 In-Use Expiration Dating

blocks.zh: 消毒劑（Sanitizer）、殺菌劑（Disinfectant）與殺孢子劑（Sporicide）在使用期間必須持續評估其效能，且不得超過書面程序所規定的預設使用期限。
blocks.en: Sanitizers, disinfectants and sporicides must be continuously evaluated for efficacy during use, and must not be used beyond the predefined in-use period specified in the written procedure.

blocks.zh: 製造商提供的有效期限，僅適用於未開封的原裝容器（Primary Container）。一旦容器被開封（無論是即用型還是濃縮液），原有效期即不再適用於活性成分效力與無菌性保證。
blocks.en: The expiration date provided by the manufacturer applies only to the unopened primary container. Once a container is opened (whether ready-to-use or concentrate), the original expiration date no longer applies to the efficacy of the active ingredient or the assurance of sterility.

blocks.zh: 使用中有效期（In-Use Expiration Dating）的兩個核心考量：
blocks.en: Two core considerations for in-use expiration dating:

blocks.zh: 消毒效力保持期：溶液在多長時間內仍能達到效力測試所驗證的殺滅能力。
blocks.en: Retention of disinfectant efficacy: how long the solution can still achieve the killing capability verified in efficacy testing.

blocks.zh: 容器生物負荷控制：在受控區域中，容器及其內容物能在多長時間內維持適當的微生物負荷水準。
blocks.en: Container bioburden control: how long the container and its contents can maintain an appropriate microbial load in a controlled area.

blocks.zh: 判定方法：在使用期末，對噴霧瓶、擠壓瓶等實際使用中的容器取樣，進行生物負荷測試（Bioburden Testing）。
blocks.en: Method of determination: at the end of the in-use period, sample containers actually in use, such as spray bottles and squeeze bottles, and perform bioburden testing.

blocks.zh: CDMO 稽核實務提醒
blocks.en: Practical Reminder for CDMO Audits

blocks.zh: 未在配製好的消毒劑容器上標示配製日期與使用期限，是 FDA 483 最常見的觀察項目之一。書面 SOP 必須明確規定每種容器與藥劑的最大使用期限。TWi 所有配製消毒劑容器均須依此標示。
blocks.en: Failing to label prepared disinfectant containers with the preparation date and expiration date is one of the most common FDA 483 observations. The written SOP must clearly specify the maximum in-use period for each container and agent. All prepared disinfectant containers at TWi must be labeled accordingly.

blocks.zh: 7.0 Control of the Environment（環境管控）
blocks.en: 7.0 Control of the Environment

blocks.zh: 7.0 概述 — 污染管控架構
blocks.en: 7.0 Overview: The Contamination Control Framework

blocks.zh: 有效的清潔消毒系統，始於限制污染物進入設施。阻止有生命（viable）與非生命（nonviable）污染物進入受控區域，是達到預期環境條件的關鍵。
blocks.en: An effective cleaning and disinfection system begins by limiting the entry of contaminants into the facility. Preventing viable and nonviable contaminants from entering controlled areas is the key to achieving the desired environmental conditions.

blocks.zh: 在整個清潔消毒流程中，污染物進入的管控是最重要的環節。這從進入設施的每一項物品的清潔度開始：物料、人員、推車、槽桶、工具、儀器，全部納入管控。
blocks.en: Throughout the cleaning and disinfection process, control of contaminant ingress is the most important element. It starts with the cleanliness of every item entering the facility: materials, personnel, carts, tanks, tools and instruments are all brought under control.

blocks.zh: 應建立進入受控區域的所有物品清單，逐一評估是否能被有效清潔、消毒或滅菌。無法適當清潔的物品，必須以可清潔的替代品取代。
blocks.en: A list of all items entering controlled areas should be established, and each item assessed for whether it can be effectively cleaned, disinfected or sterilized. Items that cannot be properly cleaned must be replaced with cleanable alternatives.

blocks.zh: 三個污染風險最高的時間節點：
blocks.en: Three time points with the highest contamination risk:

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒完成後、生產開始前：人員與物料進入區域時，可能在設置期間散落微粒與微生物。
blocks.en: After cleaning and disinfection, before production starts: personnel and materials entering the area may shed particles and microorganisms during setup.

blocks.zh: 生產干預期間：不當的潔淨室行為與差劣的無菌操作技術，可能污染已消毒表面。
blocks.en: During production interventions: improper cleanroom behavior and poor aseptic technique may contaminate disinfected surfaces.

blocks.zh: 生產結束後、清潔前：人員仍需保持無菌意識，防止環境受到污染。
blocks.en: After production ends, before cleaning: personnel must still maintain aseptic awareness to prevent contamination of the environment.

blocks.zh: 管控還必須涵蓋對已存在污染物的增殖進行防制。黴菌可滲入設備接縫等難以觸及處，造成清除困難。革蘭陰性菌若未適當清潔，可在產品接觸表面產生內毒素（Endotoxins）。
blocks.en: Control must also include preventing the proliferation of contaminants that are already present. Molds can penetrate hard-to-reach places such as equipment seams, making them difficult to remove. Gram-negative bacteria, if not properly cleaned, can produce endotoxins on product-contact surfaces.

blocks.zh: 7.1 潔淨室製造耗材的引入管控
blocks.en: 7.1 Controlling the Introduction of Cleanroom Manufacturing Supplies

blocks.zh: 設施設計與程序必須確保，物料、藥品、容器、封蓋、標籤及中間品在廠房流轉過程中不引入污染。
blocks.en: Facility design and procedures must ensure that materials, drug products, containers, closures, labels and intermediates do not introduce contamination as they move through the building.

blocks.zh: 「物料應依照適當程序消毒，或在關鍵區域使用時以適合的方法滅菌。」— 美國 FDA 工業指南：無菌加工藥品生產（cGMP）
blocks.en: "Materials should be disinfected or sterilized by an appropriate method when used in critical areas, in accordance with proper procedures." (US FDA Guidance for Industry: Sterile Drug Products Produced by Aseptic Processing, cGMP)

blocks.zh: 進入無菌加工區（APA, Aseptic Processing Area）的物品，應接受該材質所能承受的最高等級去污處理。若物品能被實體滅菌，則必須滅菌。
blocks.en: Items entering the aseptic processing area (APA) should receive the highest grade of decontamination that the material can withstand. If an item can be physically sterilized, it must be sterilized.

blocks.zh: 進入 APA 物品的滅菌方法：
blocks.en: Sterilization methods for items entering the APA:

blocks.zh: 高壓滅菌（Autoclaving）：最廣泛使用；多層外包裝可在物品進入更嚴格等級時逐層移除。
blocks.en: Autoclaving: the most widely used; multiple outer wraps can be removed layer by layer as the item moves into a stricter grade.

blocks.zh: Gamma 輻射滅菌：多層包裝/屏障，逐步移除以進入更高潔淨等級。
blocks.en: Gamma irradiation: multilayer packaging/barriers, removed progressively to enter higher cleanliness grades.

blocks.zh: VPHP（汽化過氧化氫）去污室：適用於無法承受高溫或輻射的物品。
blocks.en: VPHP (vaporized hydrogen peroxide) decontamination chamber: suitable for items that cannot withstand high temperature or radiation.

blocks.zh: 人工殺孢子消毒：以殺孢子劑噴灑或擦拭，為無法滅菌物品的最低可接受方式。
blocks.en: Manual sporicidal disinfection: spraying or wiping with a sporicide; the minimum acceptable method for items that cannot be sterilized.

blocks.zh: 紫外線（UV）穿越系統：可降低生物負荷，但不視為滅菌方法。
blocks.en: Ultraviolet (UV) pass-through systems: can reduce bioburden but are not considered a sterilization method.

blocks.zh: 若物品進入潔淨室前無法被消毒，則不得引入，必須尋找合適替代品。人員不得攜帶物品通過更衣室。
blocks.en: If an item cannot be disinfected before entering the cleanroom, it must not be introduced, and a suitable alternative must be found. Personnel must not carry items through the gowning room.

blocks.zh: 常見需執行引入程序的潔淨室耗材：維修工具、推車、生產耗材、操作器具、EM 耗材、抹布、消毒藥劑、充填設備組件、筆記用具、電子設備（量測儀、粒子計數器）。
blocks.en: Common cleanroom supplies that require an introduction procedure: maintenance tools, carts, production consumables, operating utensils, EM supplies, wipes, disinfectants, filling equipment components, writing implements, and electronic equipment (measuring instruments, particle counters).

blocks.zh: 7.1.1 潔淨室消毒藥劑類型
blocks.en: 7.1.1 Types of Cleanroom Disinfectants

blocks.zh: 潔淨室物品消毒使用三大類抗微生物化學藥劑：
blocks.en: Three major classes of antimicrobial chemical agents are used to disinfect cleanroom items:

blocks.zh: IPA 選用原則
blocks.en: Principles for Selecting IPA

blocks.zh: 除非材質相容性問題禁止，APA 物品消毒應優先選用 70% IPA，而非 70% EtOH，因 IPA 殺菌效果略勝一籌。
blocks.en: Unless material compatibility issues prohibit it, 70% IPA should be preferred over 70% EtOH for disinfecting items entering the APA, because IPA has slightly better antimicrobial efficacy.

blocks.zh: 7.1.2 槽桶、容器、推車與設備的引入管控
blocks.en: 7.1.2 Introduction of Tanks, Containers, Carts and Equipment

blocks.zh: 設備移入無菌加工系統的過程可能引入污染，必須妥善處理。理想方式為高壓滅菌或 VPHP 腔室處理，但實際上多以人工方式執行。
blocks.en: Moving equipment into the aseptic processing system can introduce contamination and must be handled with care. The ideal approach is autoclaving or treatment in a VPHP chamber, but in practice it is mostly done manually.

blocks.zh: 特別注意：推車輪子
blocks.en: Special attention: cart wheels

blocks.zh: 輪子是高風險部位，在進入 APA 前滾過非潔淨走廊，攜帶大量污染物。
blocks.en: Wheels are a high-risk location; before entering the APA they roll over non-classified corridors and carry large amounts of contamination.

blocks.zh: 人工程序：先以無微粒、不脫落的抹布擦拭輪面清潔，再施用消毒劑確保達到驗證的接觸（乾燥）時間。
blocks.en: Manual procedure: first wipe the wheel surfaces clean with non-particulating, non-shedding wipes, then apply the disinfectant, ensuring the validated contact (drying) time is achieved.

blocks.zh: VPHP 腔室程序：先用清潔劑擦拭輪子，再噴灑抗微生物藥劑後進入腔室。
blocks.en: VPHP chamber procedure: first wipe the wheels with a cleaning agent, then spray the antimicrobial agent before entering the chamber.

blocks.zh: 為何輪子格外重要
blocks.en: Why Wheels Deserve Special Attention

blocks.zh: 推車輪子在進入 APA 前，已滾過非潔淨等級走廊。每一圈轉動都在沉積地板污染物，隨後帶入潔淨室。忽視輪子消毒，是環境超標調查中頻繁發現的根本原因之一。
blocks.en: Cart wheels have already rolled over non-classified corridors before entering the APA. Each rotation deposits floor contamination, which is then carried into the cleanroom. Neglecting wheel disinfection is one of the root causes frequently found in environmental excursion investigations.

blocks.zh: 7.1.3 清潔耗材與設備的引入管控
blocks.en: 7.1.3 Introduction of Cleaning Supplies and Equipment

blocks.zh: 清潔耗材與設備本身即為潛在生物負荷來源，使用前滅菌或消毒應視為標準作業。
blocks.en: Cleaning supplies and equipment are themselves a potential source of bioburden, so sterilization or disinfection before use should be standard practice.

blocks.zh: Grade A（ISO 5）與鄰近 Grade B（ISO 5/6）區域：桶子、拖把、拖把桿、拖把頭、噴霧器、抹布、延伸桿等清潔設備，使用前必須徹底清潔並滅菌。方法：蒸汽滅菌或無菌一次性拋棄式系統。
blocks.en: Grade A (ISO 5) and adjacent Grade B (ISO 5/6) areas: cleaning equipment such as buckets, mops, mop handles, mop heads, sprayers, wipes and extension poles must be thoroughly cleaned and sterilized before use. Methods: steam sterilization or sterile single-use disposable systems.

blocks.zh: 消毒溶液的無菌性要求：消毒劑本身可能含有耐藥微生物。用於 Grade A/B 區域的溶液，必須在使用前0.2 µm 過濾滅菌或滅菌處理。方法包括：
blocks.en: Sterility requirement for disinfectant solutions: disinfectants themselves may contain resistant microorganisms. Solutions used in Grade A/B areas must be sterile-filtered through 0.2 µm or otherwise sterilized before use. Methods include:

blocks.zh: 在 Grade A/B 區域外，將最終使用濃度進行 0.2 µm 無菌過濾，注入置於 Grade A/B 區域的預滅菌容器。
blocks.en: Outside the Grade A/B area, sterile-filter the final use-concentration solution through 0.2 µm into a presterilized container placed in the Grade A/B area.

blocks.zh: 使用已驗證無菌的單劑量容器，以無菌注射用水（WFI）配製。
blocks.en: Prepare the solution with sterile water for injection (WFI) in single-dose containers validated as sterile.

blocks.zh: 向供應商採購有無菌性文件佐證的即用型或即配型無菌溶液。
blocks.en: Purchase ready-to-use or ready-to-prepare sterile solutions from suppliers, with documentation supporting their sterility.

blocks.zh: 若配方允許，高壓滅菌已配製好的溶液。
blocks.en: If the formulation allows, autoclave the prepared solution.

blocks.zh: 容器類型的選擇：會吸入空氣的容器（擠壓瓶、扳機噴霧器、反覆開蓋的大容器）會將環境污染帶入溶液中——已有 70% IPA 瓶子因吸氣而含有黴菌的案例。不吸氣容器（Non-Aspirating Containers）可避免此問題，可使用至驗證的有效期限。
blocks.en: Choice of container type: containers that draw in air (squeeze bottles, trigger sprayers, large containers that are repeatedly opened) bring environmental contamination into the solution; there have been cases of 70% IPA bottles containing mold because of air intake. Non-aspirating containers avoid this problem and can be used up to the validated expiration date.

blocks.zh: 潔淨等級遞降使用原則：Grade A 使用後的溶液可降至 Grade B、再降至 Grade C 使用，但不得反向回到 Grade A，除非容器持續保持正壓防止污染回流。開放式桶系統的溶液，每次清潔操作完畢後應丟棄。
blocks.en: Principle of stepping down cleanliness grades: a solution used in Grade A may be stepped down for use in Grade B and then Grade C, but must not go back to Grade A unless the container is kept under continuous positive pressure to prevent backflow of contamination. Solutions in open bucket systems should be discarded after each cleaning operation.

blocks.zh: 7.1.4 物料組件（Components）的引入管控
blocks.en: 7.1.4 Introduction of Components

blocks.zh: 「組件（Components）」指直接用於生產製程的物品，包括膠塞（Stoppers）、柱塞（Plungers）、西林瓶（Vials）、卡匣（Cartridges）等產品接觸物品。
blocks.en: "Components" are items used directly in the manufacturing process, including product-contact items such as stoppers, plungers, vials and cartridges.

blocks.zh: 與無菌產品直接接觸的組件，須完成去熱原（Depyrogenation）與滅菌（Sterilization）。必須使用經過驗證的滅菌製程，且在進入 APA 後直至整合入最終產品的整個過程，均須維持無菌性。
blocks.en: Components that come into direct contact with sterile product must be depyrogenated and sterilized. A validated sterilization process must be used, and sterility must be maintained from entry into the APA until the component is incorporated into the final product.

blocks.zh: 方法：乾熱法（同時完成去熱原與滅菌）或驗證過的清洗滅菌程序。在 APA 外完成滅菌的組件，應使用多層外包裝，以便在進入 Grade A（ISO 5）環境前，一層一層消毒後移除。
blocks.en: Methods: dry heat (accomplishing depyrogenation and sterilization at the same time) or a validated washing and sterilization process. Components sterilized outside the APA should use multilayer outer wraps so that they can be disinfected and removed layer by layer before entering the Grade A (ISO 5) environment.

blocks.zh: 詳細指引參閱：PDA Technical Report No. 3（2013 修訂版）：Validation of Dry Heat Processes Used for Depyrogenation and Sterilization。
blocks.en: For detailed guidance, see PDA Technical Report No. 3 (2013 revision): Validation of Dry Heat Processes Used for Depyrogenation and Sterilization.

blocks.zh: 7.2 環境監測數據分析
blocks.en: 7.2 Analysis of Environmental Monitoring Data

blocks.zh: 環境監測（EM）數據用來證明微生物污染控制系統（包括清潔消毒程序）的有效性。分析重點包括：
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring (EM) data are used to demonstrate the effectiveness of the microbial contamination control system, including the cleaning and disinfection procedures. Analysis focuses on:

blocks.zh: 回收微生物的屬種（Genus & Species）鑑定
blocks.en: Identification of recovered microorganisms to genus and species

blocks.zh: 分離株數量及其在設施內的分布
blocks.en: The number of isolates and their distribution within the facility

blocks.zh: 趨勢追蹤——與歷史數據比較
blocks.en: Trend tracking: comparison with historical data

blocks.zh: 正常狀態特徵：設施處於管控狀態時，數據呈現可預測的分布型態。最常見的分離株來自人員；來自空氣、土壤、水或液體來源的較少。
blocks.en: Features of the normal state: when a facility is in a state of control, the data show a predictable distribution pattern. The most common isolates come from personnel; fewer come from air, soil, water or liquid sources.

blocks.zh: 分析頻率：應定期進行正式、文件化的趨勢分析。清潔消毒程序有效性及警戒/行動限界適用性的評估，應至少每年執行一次。分析結果應呈報場址管理層，並由品質管理人員審查與文件化。
blocks.en: Frequency of analysis: formal, documented trend analysis should be performed regularly. The assessment of the effectiveness of the cleaning and disinfection procedures and the suitability of alert/action limits should be performed at least annually. The results should be reported to site management and reviewed and documented by quality management personnel.

blocks.zh: 異常趨勢與偏差（Excursion）：任何偏離正常狀態的情況均需採取行動，行動力度與風險相稱：
blocks.en: Abnormal trends and excursions: any departure from the normal state requires action, with the level of action commensurate with the risk:

blocks.zh: 達到警戒限（Alert Level）或出現非典型菌：提高警覺通知。
blocks.en: Alert level reached or atypical organisms found: raise awareness through notification.

blocks.zh: 多次超過行動限（Action Level）：對該區域進行特別清潔消毒。
blocks.en: Action level exceeded multiple times: perform special cleaning and disinfection of the area.

blocks.zh: 多個監測點或多次發生：展開完整調查。
blocks.en: Multiple monitoring locations or repeated occurrences: initiate a full investigation.

blocks.zh: 菌種特異性回應：超過行動限的營養細胞，可能需要加強消毒。偵測到超過行動限的孢子形成菌，則需立即以殺孢子劑進行處理。
blocks.en: Organism-specific response: vegetative cells exceeding the action level may require enhanced disinfection. Detection of spore-formers exceeding the action level requires immediate treatment with a sporicide.

blocks.zh: 7.3 環境分離株的取得與選用
blocks.en: 7.3 Obtaining and Selecting Environmental Isolates

blocks.zh: 超過警戒限或行動限時，必須將 EM 回收的微生物鑑定至屬種層級（Genus & Species）；即使未超限，也應定期進行鑑定。
blocks.en: When an alert or action level is exceeded, microorganisms recovered by EM must be identified to genus and species level; identification should also be performed periodically even when no limit is exceeded.

blocks.zh: 應評估鑑定結果，確認最常出現的菌種，並保存代表性菌株，納入設施所使用消毒藥劑效力測試（Efficacy Testing）的測試菌株組合。
blocks.en: The identification results should be evaluated to determine the most frequently occurring species, and representative strains should be retained and included in the panel of test organisms used for efficacy testing of the disinfectants used in the facility.

blocks.zh: 閉迴路管控：EM 與效力驗證的連結
blocks.en: Closed-Loop Control: Linking EM and Efficacy Validation

blocks.zh: 本節點將環境監測與清潔驗證緊密連結。你在設施中找到的菌種，應成為消毒劑資格測試的測試菌株——確保效力數據反映真實的污染輪廓，而非僅依賴標準挑戰菌株。這是清潔驗證資料包（Cleaning Validation Package）的重要組成部分。
blocks.en: This node closely links environmental monitoring with cleaning validation. The species you find in your facility should become the test organisms for disinfectant qualification, ensuring that the efficacy data reflect the real contamination profile and do not rely only on standard challenge organisms. This is an important part of the cleaning validation package.

blocks.zh: 8.0 In-Situ Field Studies（現場實地研究）
blocks.en: 8.0 In-Situ Field Studies

blocks.zh: 8.0 現場實地研究 — 概述
blocks.en: 8.0 In-Situ Field Studies: Overview

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒程序有效性的真正考驗，是從生產區域收集的監測數據。評估來自健全環境監測計劃的現場（In-Situ）數據，能驗證程序是否能達到並維持所需的清潔度，將污染風險降至最低。
blocks.en: The real test of the effectiveness of cleaning and disinfection procedures is the monitoring data collected from production areas. Evaluating in-situ data from a sound environmental monitoring program verifies whether the procedure can achieve and maintain the required cleanliness and minimize contamination risk.

blocks.zh: In-situ 數據類型包含：
blocks.en: Types of in-situ data include:

blocks.zh: 非活性微粒（Non-viable Particulate）數據
blocks.en: Nonviable particulate data

blocks.zh: 表面與環境空氣的活菌（Viable）數據
blocks.en: Viable data from surfaces and environmental air

blocks.zh: 人員監測數據
blocks.en: Personnel monitoring data

blocks.zh: 代表性環境分離株的微生物鑑定結果
blocks.en: Microbial identification results for representative environmental isolates

blocks.zh: 表面殘留測試（Residual Testing）
blocks.en: Residual testing of surfaces

blocks.zh: 產品品質數據（中間品生物負荷與無菌測試）
blocks.en: Product quality data (bioburden of intermediates and sterility testing)

blocks.zh: 現場監測常用兩種方法：
blocks.en: Two methods are commonly used for field monitoring:

blocks.zh: 設施或區域啟用前後的環境監測（第 8.1 節）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring before and after commissioning of a facility or area (Section 8.1)

blocks.zh: 例行生產期間清潔前後的環境監測（第 8.2 節）
blocks.en: Environmental monitoring before and after cleaning during routine production (Section 8.2)

blocks.zh: 實驗室 vs. 真實生產環境
blocks.en: Laboratory vs. the Real Production Environment

blocks.zh: 實驗室的測試片（Coupon）研究使用受控菌液、拋光不鏽鋼材質——表面光滑、條件穩定、結果可重現。但真實潔淨室有環氧樹脂地板、壓克力窗、不規則設備表面，還有人員干預。In-situ 研究彌合這個落差，確認程序在真實作業條件、真實表面材質、真實操作人員下同樣有效。這是清潔驗證資料包的核心支撐。
blocks.en: Laboratory coupon studies use controlled microbial suspensions and polished stainless steel: smooth surfaces, stable conditions and reproducible results. But a real cleanroom has epoxy floors, acrylic windows, irregular equipment surfaces, and personnel interventions. In-situ studies bridge this gap, confirming that the procedure is equally effective under real operating conditions, real surface materials and real operators. This is the core support for the cleaning validation package.

blocks.zh: 8.1 設施或區域啟用前後的環境監測
blocks.en: 8.1 Environmental Monitoring Before and After Facility or Area Start-Up

blocks.zh: 適用情境：新區域開啟、因異常事件關閉的區域、已進行重大改造的區域，或閒置較長時間的區域。
blocks.en: Applicable situations: opening of a new area, an area closed because of an abnormal event, an area that has undergone major renovation, or an area that has been idle for an extended period.

blocks.zh: 針對停工或重大施工活動，設施應備有專屬的啟動清潔消毒程序（Start-up C&D Program）。
blocks.en: For shutdowns or major construction activities, the facility should have a dedicated start-up cleaning and disinfection (C&D) program.

blocks.zh: 標準方法——每個階段後進行 EM：
blocks.en: Standard approach: EM after each stage:

blocks.zh: 初步清潔：移除粗大污垢（掃帚、吸塵器）——例如施工完成後，為後續正式清潔程序做準備。
blocks.en: Preliminary cleaning: remove gross dirt (brooms, vacuums), for example after construction is completed, in preparation for the subsequent formal cleaning procedure.

blocks.zh: 基線監測：加強空氣與表面的活菌監測；同時進行非活性微粒監測。此步驟建立清潔前基線數據作為比較基準。
blocks.en: Baseline monitoring: enhanced viable monitoring of air and surfaces, together with nonviable particulate monitoring. This step establishes pre-cleaning baseline data as a basis for comparison.

blocks.zh: 執行清潔消毒：執行完整的清潔消毒程序。
blocks.en: Perform cleaning and disinfection: carry out the full cleaning and disinfection procedure.

blocks.zh: 清潔後監測：表面乾燥後，重複加強的表面活菌監測與非活性微粒監測。
blocks.en: Post-cleaning monitoring: after the surfaces have dried, repeat the enhanced viable surface monitoring and nonviable particulate monitoring.

blocks.zh: 數據分析：比對清潔前後數據。健全的清潔消毒程序應能證明活菌與非活性微粒數量顯著下降，並最小化孢子形成菌或黴菌的存在。若結果未達可接受的降低水準，必須檢討並修改程序。
blocks.en: Data analysis: compare the data before and after cleaning. A sound cleaning and disinfection procedure should demonstrate a significant decrease in viable and nonviable particulate counts and minimize the presence of spore-formers or mold. If the results do not reach an acceptable level of reduction, the procedure must be reviewed and revised.

blocks.zh: 8.2 例行生產期間清潔前後的環境監測
blocks.en: 8.2 Environmental Monitoring Before and After Cleaning During Routine Production

blocks.zh: 此方法針對正常生產運行中的設施，用於評估清潔消毒程序的持續有效性：
blocks.en: This method targets a facility in normal production operation and is used to evaluate the ongoing effectiveness of the cleaning and disinfection procedure:

blocks.zh: 在生產操作完成後、清潔消毒執行前，加強表面與空氣的活菌監測，並進行非活性微粒監測。
blocks.en: After production operations are complete and before cleaning and disinfection, perform enhanced viable monitoring of surfaces and air, together with nonviable particulate monitoring.

blocks.zh: 執行清潔消毒程序。
blocks.en: Perform the cleaning and disinfection procedure.

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒完成後，再次進行加強監測。
blocks.en: After cleaning and disinfection is complete, perform enhanced monitoring again.

blocks.zh: 分析清潔前後的數據。預期：活菌與非活性微粒數量下降，孢子形成菌或黴菌最小化。若結果未達要求，必須檢討並修改程序。
blocks.en: Analyze the data from before and after cleaning. Expectation: viable and nonviable particulate counts decrease, and spore-formers or mold are minimized. If the results do not meet the requirements, the procedure must be reviewed and revised.

blocks.zh: 延伸參考：PDA Technical Report No. 13（2014 修訂版）：Fundamentals of an Environmental Monitoring Program。
blocks.en: Further reference: PDA Technical Report No. 13 (2014 revision): Fundamentals of an Environmental Monitoring Program.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用 — 清潔驗證資料包
blocks.en: CDMO Application: The Cleaning Validation Package

blocks.zh: 8.1 與 8.2 的 in-situ 研究，產生支撐清潔驗證資料包（Cleaning Validation Package）所需的現場關鍵數據。法規機關期望看到文件化的清潔前後 EM 數據，以證明清潔程序在真實生產條件下的有效性，而不僅是實驗室測試片研究結果。
blocks.en: The in-situ studies in 8.1 and 8.2 generate the key field data needed to support the cleaning validation package. Regulators expect to see documented EM data from before and after cleaning to demonstrate that the cleaning procedure is effective under real production conditions, and not only the results of laboratory coupon studies.

blocks.zh: Section Summary — 本節總結
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 重點摘要（繁體中文）
blocks.en: Key Takeaways (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 使用中有效期（第 6.0 節）：消毒劑容器一旦開封，製造商有效期即失效。必須定義使用期限並在容器上標示配製日期與到期日——此為最常見的 FDA 483 觀察項目。
blocks.en: In-use expiration dating (Section 6.0): once a disinfectant container is opened, the manufacturer's expiration date is no longer valid. An in-use period must be defined, and the preparation date and expiration date must be labeled on the container; this is the most common FDA 483 observation.

blocks.zh: 環境管控（第 7.0 節）：污染防制從清潔啟動前就開始——從物品進入的那一刻。每件進入 APA 的物品都需要書面去污程序，且應使用材質所能承受的最高去污等級。
blocks.en: Environmental control (Section 7.0): contamination prevention begins before cleaning starts, from the moment an item enters. Every item entering the APA needs a written decontamination procedure, using the highest level of decontamination the material can withstand.

blocks.zh: 消毒溶液的無菌性：用於 Grade A/B 的消毒劑必須先行 0.2 µm 過濾滅菌或其他滅菌處理。不吸氣容器可防止環境污染進入，為優先選擇。
blocks.en: Sterility of disinfectant solutions: disinfectants used in Grade A/B must first be sterile-filtered through 0.2 µm or otherwise sterilized. Non-aspirating containers prevent environmental contamination from entering and are the preferred choice.

blocks.zh: EM 數據分析（第 7.2–7.3 節）：EM 數據必須定期進行趨勢分析。環境分離株應鑑定並用於更新效力測試菌株組合，形成監測與消毒資格認證之間的閉迴路管控。
blocks.en: EM data analysis (Sections 7.2–7.3): EM data must be trended regularly. Environmental isolates should be identified and used to update the panel of efficacy test organisms, forming a closed loop between monitoring and disinfectant qualification.

blocks.zh: 現場實地研究（第 8.0 節）：清潔事件前後的 EM 數據，提供實驗室效力數據所無法取代的現場驗證證據。啟用情境與例行生產均須涵蓋。此數據為清潔驗證資料包的核心。
blocks.en: In-situ field studies (Section 8.0): EM data from before and after cleaning events provide field validation evidence that laboratory efficacy data cannot replace. Both start-up scenarios and routine production must be covered. These data are the core of the cleaning validation package.
